name: zeb/potoru
description: Potoru 2D animation for RWE templates. PotoPlayer plays .poto stories (canvas renderer, play / slide / interactive modes, host bridge set / fire / report); PotoSnapshot draws one still frame (thumbnails, galleries, storyboards) without the interaction or music engines; PotoEditor and compile() compile Potoru sources in the browser in two modes: YAML (a format v4 source folder) and Script (experimental: authoring-API JavaScript in a sandbox). The entry bundle is a small bridge; each part loads on demand from files next to it. Fully offline.

source.package: @potoru/player + @potoru/authoring (built from Potoru sources; not on npm yet)
